title: Concept: Dynamic method dispatch from a non-literal name in ruby — review required
description: In ruby, send is given a computed method name. The receiver then runs whatever public method the value names, so a request parameter can reach methods that were never routed or authorized. The idiom is common in "generic" controllers and service objects, where the method set is assumed to be harmless.
applicability: ruby applications that dispatch methods from parameters.
risk: Invocation of unintended methods and authorization bypass; MEDIUM severity.
